title: Issue-version ledger
summary: Record the issue-to-version binding, acceptance criteria, and current disposition.
acceptance_criteria: A new issue receives the next available number and repeat registration preserves its mapping.
The ledger distinguishes issue identity from suffix and orders .9, .10, and .150 numerically.
Duplicate and retired assignments are recorded without reusing an identifier.

evidence.claim: Draft design and acceptance criteria only.
